title: BenchmarkPairTrialVerdict
description: One blind A/B trial verdict for the co-evolution benchmark's pairwise judging. Field names match evals/judge-bounce.sh's trial verdict exactly so evals/lib/judge-lib.sh's decode and evidence-verification helpers work unchanged.

better.description: Which plan is better, or tie when they are equivalent.

doc.description: Which plan the quote is copied from.

quote.description: Verbatim quote of 5-25 words from that plan. Quotes are grep-verified against the plan; fabricated quotes invalidate the verdict.
